results.rule: Every pull request references at least one issue number in its title or its body.
results.step:
- name: Enforce rule
  run: |
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail

    payload="$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"

    title=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(d.get('pull_request',{}).get('title',''))" "$payload")
    body=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(d.get('pull_request',{}).get('body',''))" "$payload")

    if [[ "$title$body" =~ #[0-9]+ ]]; then
        exit 0
    else
        exit 1
    fi
results.body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

payload="$GITHUB_EVENT_PATH"

title=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(d.get('pull_request',{}).get('title',''))" "$payload")
body=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(d.get('pull_request',{}).get('body',''))" "$payload")

if [[ "$title$body" =~ #[0-9]+ ]]; then
    exit 0
else
    exit 1
fi

results.rule: Every commit message follows conventional commits, `type(scope): subject`.
results.step:
- name: Enforce rule
  run: |
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    while IFS= read -r msg; do
      if ! [[ "$msg" =~ ^[a-z]+\([^)]+\): .+ ]]; then
        echo "Invalid commit message: $msg"
        exit 1
      fi
    done < <(git log --format=%s)
    exit 0

  fi

results.rule: No security step carries `continue-on-error: true`.
results.step:
- name: Enforce rule
  run: |
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -euo pipefail

    violation=0

    # Find all workflow files
    while IFS= read -r f; do
        # Skip if not a regular file
        [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue

        # Get line numbers of continue-on-error: true (case-insensitive)
        while IFS=: read -r _ lnum _; do
            # Get the line with continue-on-error and the previous line
            line=$(sed -n "${lnum}p" "$f")
            prev_line=""
            if (( lnum > 1 )); then
                prev_line=$(sed -n "$((lnum-1))p" "$f")
            fi

            line_lc=$(echo "$line" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
            prev_lc=$(echo "$prev_line" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')

            # Check for continue-on-error: true and security in either line
            if [[ "$line_lc" =~ continue-on-error:[[:space:]]*true ]] && \
               ( [[ "$prev_lc" =~ security ]] || [[ "$line_lc" =~ security ]] ); then
                echo "Violation: security step with continue-on-error: true in $f:$lnum"
                violation=1
                break 2
            fi
        done < <(grep -n -i "continue-on-error: true" "$f" || true)
    done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" \) 2>/dev/null || true)

    if (( violation )); then
        exit 1
    else
        exit 0
    fi

results.rule: Every third-party action is pinned to a commit SHA, not to a tag.
results.step:
- name: Enforce rule
  run: |
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    violation=0
    while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
        while IFS= read -r line; do
            trimmed=$(echo "$line" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
            if [[ $trimmed == \#* ]]; then
                continue
            fi
            if [[ $line =~ uses:[[:space:]] ]]; then
                value=${line#*uses:}
                value=$(echo "$value" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]#].*//' -e "s/['\"]//g")
                if [[ -z $value ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                if [[ $value == .* ]] || [[ $value == ./]* ]]; then
                    continue
                fi
                if [[ $value == *@* ]]; then
                    ref=${value#*@}
                else
                    ref=""
                fi
                if [[ -z $ref ]]; then
                    violation=1
                    break 2
                fi
                if ! [[ $ref =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ ]]; then
                    violation=1
                    break 2
                fi
            fi
        done < "$file"
        if [[ $violation -ne 0 ]]; then
            break
        fi
    done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" \) -print0 2>/dev/null)
    if [[ $violation -ne 0 ]]; then
        exit 1
    else
        exit 0
    fi

results.rule: Every workflow declares `timeout-minutes`.
results.step:
- name: Enforce rule
  run: |
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    set -e
    missing=0
    while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
        if ! grep -E '^[[:space:]]*timeout-minutes[[:space:]]*:' "$file" >/dev/null; then
            echo "Workflow $file missing timeout-minutes"
            missing=1
        fi
    done < <(find .github/workflows -type f \( -name "*.yml" -o -name "*.yaml" \) -print0)
    if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ]; then
        exit 1
    fi
    exit 0

results.rule: Every source directory has a corresponding test directory.
results.step:
- name: Enforce rule
  run: |
    #!/usr/bin/env bash
    if [ -d src ]; then
        missing=0
        while IFS= read -r srcdir; do
            rel="${srcdir#src/}"
            testdir="tests/$rel"
            if [ ! -d "$testdir" ]; then
                echo "Missing test directory for source: $srcdir"
                missing=1
            fi
        done < <(find src -type d)
        if [ "$missing" -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    exit 0
